origin.ownerFed: Added by you, now from Sonarr: {{name}}

counts.none: No monitored episode has aired yet

numbering.title: The seasons here look different from {{name}}.
numbering.why: TMDB splits this series into other seasons than {{name}}. Searching and matching keep using the numbers from {{name}}; there is nothing to set. Each episode shows its number from {{name}}.
numbering.unmatched_one: nexcrate does not find {{value}} episode from {{name}} on TMDB.
numbering.unmatched_other: nexcrate does not find {{value}} episodes from {{name}} on TMDB.

late.text_one: TMDB added {{value}} episode long after it aired. nexcrate does not monitor it by itself.
late.text_other: TMDB added {{value}} episodes long after they aired. nexcrate does not monitor them by itself.
late.done: The episodes added late are monitored now.

daily.label: Daily show: episodes by date
daily.hint: Daily shows name their episodes by date instead of by number.
daily.proposed: TMDB lists the series as a talk show or news. nexcrate therefore proposes dates.

seasons.title: Seasons
seasons.intro: One column per version. Click an episode to see its file, numbers and switch.
seasons.empty: TMDB lists no episode in this season yet.
seasons.sourceOnlyText: Not on TMDB. Searching and loading do not work for this special.
seasons.sourceOnlyEpisodeText: Not on TMDB. Searching and loading do not work for this episode.
seasons.deleteFilesLabel: Delete the files of {{season}} in the version {{label}}

episode.fed: Monitored, as in {{name}}. Change it there.
episode.fedOff: Not monitored, as in {{name}}. Change it there.
episode.late: TMDB added the episode long after it aired. nexcrate does not monitor it by itself.
episode.gone: TMDB no longer lists this episode. It stays because something hangs on it.
episode.downloadingOwn: A download is loading this episode.
episode.downloadingOwnPercent: A download is loading this episode, {{percent}} %.
episode.problemOwn: The download of this episode needs you.
episode.released: The file is released and now under “Not assigned”. Nothing changed on disk.
episode.deleteFileLabel: Delete the file of {{number}} in the version {{label}}

unassigned.title: Not assigned
unassigned.intro: These files from {{name}} fit no episode on TMDB. nexcrate leaves them as they are.
unassigned.ownIntro: These files lie in this version's series folder but belong to no episode. Assign them; until then nexcrate only fetches new episodes. Nothing on disk is changed.
unassigned.proposalUnknown: nexcrate has a proposal for this file.
unassigned.twice: The same episode is listed twice.
unassigned.noNearby: This version has no episode without a file around that place.
unassigned.leftOut: The file stays on disk and no longer counts as unclear.

reason.no_numbers: The name holds no episode number.
reason.unknown_numbers: TMDB does not list the numbers in the name for this series.
reason.ambiguous: The name fits more than one episode.
reason.counted_otherwise: The file counts differently from TMDB.
reason.episode_has_file: Its episode already has a file in this version.
reason.duplicate: Two files mean the same episode. The better one is assigned.

unassigned.proposalsNone: Nothing assigned: no proposal was left open.
unassigned.confirmNames_one: {{value}} proposal comes from the file name: nexcrate found the episode title inside the name. That is mostly right, but not always. Look at a few proposals before you take them all.
unassigned.confirmNames_other: {{value}} proposals come from the file name: nexcrate found the episode title inside the name. That is mostly right, but not always. Look at a few proposals before you take them all.
unassigned.confirmSafe_one: {{value}} more proposal rests on the episode title from Sonarr.
unassigned.confirmSafe_other: {{value}} more proposals rest on the episode title from Sonarr.
unassigned.jump_one: {{value}} file belongs to no episode. Until you assign it, nexcrate only fetches new episodes of this series.
unassigned.jump_other: {{value}} files belong to no episode. Until you assign them, nexcrate only fetches new episodes of this series.
unassigned.occupied: Reads as {{episodes}}. The episode has a file already: {{path}}
unassigned.instead: Take instead of the current one
unassigned.insteadLabel: Take instead of the current one: {{path}}
unassigned.replaced: Assigned. The episode's previous file is now under “Not assigned”; nothing changed on disk.
unassigned.willReplace: Replaces the file of this episode: {{path}}. It is under “Not assigned” afterwards.

read.hint: Reads new files in the series folder. Known files stay as they are.
read.started: The series folder is being read. What comes out of it shows up here.
read.queued: The folder is queued for reading.

watchDialog.title: Change what it monitors
watchDialog.specials: You monitor specials one by one at their season.
watchDialog.overridden_one: {{value}} switch set by hand is overwritten.
watchDialog.overridden_other: {{value}} switches set by hand are overwritten.
watchDialog.after: Monitored afterwards: {{watched}} episodes, {{aired}} of them aired.
watchDialog.saved: {{label}} monitors by the new rule now.

add.title: Add a series
add.idle: Type the title of a series. nexcrate searches it on TMDB.
add.pickVersionsHint: For each version you set which episodes it monitors. You add more versions later on the page of the series.
add.specials: You monitor specials one by one on the page of the series.
add.noVersions: There is no version for series yet. Add one first, for example Full-HD.
add.allExist: {{title}} has every version there is for series. You add more versions under Settings.

empty.title: No series yet
empty.sonarrText: If you use Sonarr, nexcrate reads your series with their files. Nothing changes in Sonarr.
empty.searchText: Search a series on TMDB and set which episodes you want.
empty.diskText: nexcrate reads your series folders, assigns the files to their episodes and never loads any of them again.

history.renumbered: TMDB renumbered an episode: {{from}} is {{to}} now
history.fileRelinked: {{version}}: file moved from {{from}} to {{to}}, the bridge to TVDB was wrong
history.fileLinked: {{version}}: unclear file placed on {{to}}, the bridge to TVDB was wrong
history.fileReleased: {{version}}: file released from {{from}}, the bridge to TVDB was wrong; it waits under "Not assigned"
history.skipped_one: {{count}} file left out, the file there is not worse
history.skipped_other: {{count}} files left out, the files there are not worse

import.title: Import from Sonarr
import.intro: If you use Sonarr already, nexcrate reads your series with seasons, episodes and files from there.
import.readOnly: nexcrate only reads. Nothing is changed, deleted or searched in Sonarr.
import.schedule: Sonarr stays in charge. nexcrate reads again every 15 minutes and shows your series. nexcrate loads nothing for these series.
import.tmdbNeeded: Series need the TMDB key. It is under Settings, Online services.
import.nameHint: Any name, for example Sonarr HD.
import.urlHint: The address you open Sonarr with in the browser, with port.
import.versionHint: Every series from this Sonarr becomes this version in nexcrate.
import.matched: {{matched}} episodes matched, {{unmatched}} without a fitting TMDB episode
import.filesUnmatched_one: {{value}} file fits no TMDB episode. It is listed on the page of its series.
import.filesUnmatched_other: {{value}} files fit no TMDB episode. They are listed on the page of their series.
import.removeText: The connection {{name}} disappears from nexcrate, together with everything that came into the library through it. Nothing changes in Sonarr.

versions.title: Versions for series
versions.intro: A version is one edition of the same series, for example Full-HD and 4K. Each version monitors its own episodes.
versions.removeText: The version {{label}} disappears from nexcrate. This only works while no series and no Sonarr connection uses it.

folders.hint: nexcrate stores new series of this version here. Series from Sonarr stay in their folder.
folders.noVersions: There is no version for series yet.
folders.seasonLike: Jellyfin reads this folder name as a season and matches series in it wrongly.

numberingDialog.title: Numbering
numberingDialog.intro: How releases count this series. nexcrate searches with this and matches releases to episodes with it.
numberingDialog.groupHint: If releases count this series differently from TMDB, for example by DVD, an episode group from TMDB may fit. nexcrate never picks one by itself.
numberingDialog.noGroups: TMDB lists no episode group for this series.
numberingDialog.aliasesHint: Other titles releases of this series appear under. nexcrate asks for them first.
numberingDialog.aliasesNone: No search title of your own yet.
numberingDialog.aliasTooLong: A search title has at most 200 characters.
numberingDialog.aliasExists: This search title is already there.
numberingDialog.aliasesFull: More than 50 search titles are not possible.
numberingDialog.corrections_one: {{value}} episode has a local correction. You change it at the episode.
numberingDialog.corrections_other: {{value}} episodes have a local correction. You change them at the episode.
numberingDialog.xemOld: Scene numbers may be out of date.

xemState.no_tvdb: cannot be asked without a TVDB number
xemState.xem_blocked: blocked, maybe by a filter in your own network

numberingDialog.sceneNumberingHint_one: {{value}} episode has a scene number (from TheXEM or Sonarr). Off: nexcrate reads and searches releases without it, the numbers stay stored.
numberingDialog.sceneNumberingHint_other: {{value}} episodes have a scene number (from TheXEM or Sonarr). Off: nexcrate reads and searches releases without it, the numbers stay stored.

correction.title: In releases this episode is called
correction.episodeEndHint: Only for a double episode, otherwise empty.
correction.following: Count on for the following episodes
correction.followingHint: The later episodes of this season get the numbers after it.
correction.invalid: Season and episode are whole numbers from 0 to 9999. To episode is at most 10 after the episode.
correction.absoluteHint: The number releases count the episode through by ("Title - 148"). Leave it empty for nexcrate to work it out.
correction.numbersHint: Leave season and episode empty when only the number counted through differs.
correction.invalidAnime: Season and episode go together and are whole numbers from 0 to 9999, the number counted through from 1 to 9999. One of the two must be there.

xem.title: TheXEM
xem.hint: Fetches scene numbers from thexem.info. Without TheXEM nexcrate finds less for series that releases count differently from TMDB.

version.problemLine: A download of this version needs you.

automatic.on: Automation searches the aired watched episodes right away and new ones from the day after they air.
automatic.off: Automation for series is off. You can search on the series page.

type.label: Kind of series
type.hint: Decides how nexcrate counts, searches and names episodes.
type.standardHint: Episodes are called S01E01. That fits almost everything.
type.dailyHint: Talk shows and news name their episodes by the date instead of by a number.
type.animeHint: Anime are often counted through the whole series (episode 148 instead of S05E03). nexcrate then searches by both ways of counting and files the files by the number counted through.
type.fed: The Sonarr connection that feeds this series decides its kind. Change it there, or the next run takes it back.
